m_k8s_samples_refresh_paused: Automatic summary refresh is paused while reading. Click Refresh to load the current range.
m_k8s_history_stale: Update failed. Showing the last successful chart result.
m_k8s_only_abnormal: Only not-ready, restarted or alerting objects
m_k8s_scope_unavailable: The selected scope {scope} is unavailable or disabled. Select a scope to continue; another scope will not be selected automatically.
m_k8s_disable_cluster_help: Disable monitoring for this cluster and its namespaces. Registrations and history are retained. Edit the cluster to enable it again.
m_k8s_disable_namespace_help: Disable monitoring for this namespace. Its registration and history are retained. Edit it to enable it again.
m_k8s_clear_targets_help: Clear all current log and application metric targets for this node. Historical metrics and log files are retained. Discovered targets may be generated again. Use the Agent disable action to keep collection disabled.
m_k8s_log_rules_draft_help: This editor only updates the outer draft. After applying, click Save and publish in the log targets dialog to deliver the configuration to the Agent.
m_k8s_unsaved_help: Changes have not been published. Closing or leaving this page will discard them.
m_k8s_save_failed: Save failed or the response timed out. Your draft is retained. Retry; a timeout does not necessarily mean the server did not save the configuration.
m_k8s_agent_config_failed: Failed to load node target configuration. Retry.
m_k8s_rule_list_failed: Failed to load alert rules. Retry.
m_k8s_no_filter_results: No results match the current filters. Adjust the filters.
m_k8s_threshold_catalog_help: Metric units are unavailable. Refresh the catalog to confirm the threshold meaning. The numeric value is saved unchanged.
m_k8s_threshold_cores_help: Unit: CPU cores. For example, 0.5 means half a core and 1 means one core.
m_k8s_threshold_bytes_help: Unit: bytes. For example, 1048576 = 1 MiB and 1073741824 = 1 GiB.
m_k8s_threshold_throttled_help: Unit: s/s, accumulated CPU throttled time per second. For example, 0.2 means 0.2 seconds throttled per second; this is not CPU utilization percent.
m_k8s_threshold_throughput_help: Unit: bytes/s. For example, 1024 means 1 KiB/s.
m_k8s_threshold_window_help: Unit: events per window. The current count window is {seconds} seconds; the threshold compares the increase in that window.
m_k8s_threshold_rate_help: Unit: events/s, the number of events per second.
m_k8s_threshold_count_help: Unit: cumulative count or quantity, compared using the raw metric value.
m_k8s_threshold_state_help: State values are usually 0 or 1. For Ready and log health, 1 means healthy; for last termination OOM, 1 means an OOM occurred.
m_k8s_threshold_raw_help: Unit: {unit}. Values are compared and saved without conversion.
m_k8s_rule_selector_help: An empty selector does not restrict that field. The rule applies to matching objects in the current namespace.
m_k8s_for_seconds_help: Fire after the condition remains violated for this many seconds; 0 means no waiting period.
m_k8s_recover_after_help: Recover after this many consecutive normal evaluations, not seconds; 0 is treated as 1 evaluation.
m_k8s_sources_failed: Failed to load clusters or namespaces. Please retry.
m_k8s_history_failed: Metric query failed. Refresh to retry.
m_k8s_log_samples_help: Shows representative samples collected by Prometheus for the selected Pod/container and time range. Time is when the Agent selected the line. Samples are rate limited; their number differs from the event count and they are not complete logs. Use pod_uid in the details to distinguish Pod incarnations.
m_k8s_log_samples_failed: Log sample query failed. Refresh to retry.
m_k8s_log_samples_empty: No collected samples in this range. There may be no new matches, an older Agent, sample limits, missing Prometheus collection, or expired retention. This does not mean there were no log matches.
m_k8s_log_samples_limited: Query limit reached. Showing up to the latest {limit} representative samples; more may exist. Narrow the time range.
m_k8s_log_sample_labels: View full source and rule metadata
m_k8s_log_sample_copy_failed: Copy failed. Select and copy the sample manually.
m_k8s_no_metric_data: No samples in this time range. Missing data does not mean zero or healthy.
m_k8s_series_details: Series details ({count}, expand to view all labels)
m_k8s_inventory_failed: Object inventory refresh failed. The displayed inventory may be outdated.
m_k8s_catalog_failed: Failed to load the metric catalog.
m_k8s_select_object: Select a Pod/container to view metric charts and related alerts.
m_k8s_logical_history_help: History follows object names. Pod incarnations have separate UID series, and missing samples leave gaps. Network and Pod Ready/Phase are Pod metrics; source health is a namespace metric.
m_k8s_count_window_help: Log matches count new events in a rolling {seconds}-second window. Health 1 means healthy, 0 unhealthy; missing data is unknown.
m_k8s_app_chart_help: Only supported Agent application metrics are available. No *_metric.log means no samples. Counters show rates; histograms show event rates or mean duration. Mean duration is empty without events. Application dimensions have separate series.
m_k8s_invalid_time_range: Select a valid historical time range, up to 30 days.
m_k8s_chart_limit: Show up to six metrics per tab.
m_k8s_no_namespace: Register and enable a cluster and namespace in monitoring sources first.
m_k8s_object_metric_help: Last 15 minutes for the current Pod instance. Missing data is not healthy. Log matches are increases over 5 minutes; log health: 1 healthy, 0 unhealthy.
m_k8s_disable_help: Collection stays disabled until manually enabled, even if the agent reports again.
m_legend_tips: Select One Or Manually Configure, Format $tag1,$tag2,...
m_dangerous_confirm_tip: I Acknowledge This Operation Is High Risk And Have Assessed All Risks, Confirm To Proceed And Bear The Consequences.
m_resource_delete_tip: Risk Tip: Deleting The Hierarchical Object Will Delete All Its Child Nodes And All Associated Business Log Metrics, Business Database Metrics, Business Keyword Configs, And Applied Metrics And Alert Configs.
m_delete_follow: About To Delete The Following Data
m_k8s_sources_intro: Register Kubernetes API clusters and select the namespaces to monitor. Credentials are stored encrypted.
m_k8s_clusters_help: Register each cluster API Server once. CA is optional; when omitted, server certificate validation is skipped. Namespaces use their cluster's API Server and CA.
m_k8s_no_cluster: No cluster is registered. Add a cluster before registering namespaces.
m_k8s_namespaces_help: Only enabled namespaces listed here are collected. An empty token inherits the cluster token.
m_k8s_cluster_token_required: A Cluster token is required when creating a cluster.
m_k8s_cluster_token_edit_help: Leave empty to keep the saved token. Enter a new value to rotate it.
m_k8s_cluster_fields_required: Cluster ID and API Server are required.
m_k8s_namespace_token_help: Leave empty to use the cluster token. Enter a value only when this namespace has its own credential.
m_k8s_agent_empty: No agents have reported for this cluster. Agents will appear here after they come online.
m_k8s_log_agent_auto_register: Log agents register their address automatically; configure log rules in the log management page.
m_k8s_log_defaults_help: Reset updates the default ERROR rule, clears its line exclusions and resets file exclusions to skip archives containing a YYYY-MM-DD, YYYYMMDD, YYYY_MM_DD or YYYY.MM.DD date between .log and the final .log suffix for every ordinary log target on this Agent. Other custom rules and application metric targets are preserved. Changes take effect only after clicking Save and publish.
m_k8s_log_defaults_reset: Draft reset. Review the changes and click Save and publish.
m_k8s_log_exclude_help: A line counts only when it matches the main rule and none of its exclusions. Literal text is case-sensitive; regex supports (?i) for case-insensitive matching. Exclusions affect only their own rule. An empty list excludes nothing. Rule versions are managed by the server.
m_k8s_invalid_log_rule: Provide unique rule IDs, patterns, valid match modes and complete exclusions. Remove unused exclusions.
m_k8s_no_log_targets: No ordinary log targets are available. Wait for discovery or configure a log target first.
m_tip_for_save: Config Must Be Complete To Save!
m_already_initiated: The Alert Has Already Initiated Orchestration
m_is_start_match_tip: Matching Will Clear JSON Key And Matching Results In Collection Parameters, Confirm Matching?
m_metric_prefix_code_validate: Please enter 1 to 15 letters (beginning) or numbers
m_alarm_tips: Config Here Applies To All Warnings, For Individual Config, Go To [Alarm List - Alarm - Edit - Config Window], Configure Orchestration And Notification
m_choose_one: Can Only Select One Owner Role
m_empty_data_recrisive: No Data (Please Add Associated Objects In [Monitor Config - Object Hierarchy - Current Level Object], Contact Admin If In Doubt)
m_empty_data_endpoint: No Data (Please Add Current Object To A Group In [Monitor Config - Object - Object Group], Contact Admin If In Doubt)
m_metric_deleteTips: Confirm Delete Metric? Deletion Is Irreversible And Affects Dashboards And Alert Lists. Please Proceed With Caution.
m_button_receiversConfiguration: Threshold Alert Trigger Notification and Orchestration
m_button_processConfiguration_tip1: Process Name Refer To /proc/{pid}/status File's Name
m_tips_dashboardEmpty: No Homepage Set, Please Go To Custom Views
m_delConfirm_tip: Data Cannot Be Recovered After Deletion, Confirm?
m_regularization_check_failed_tips: Only strings that start with English, may contain English, numbers, underscores, and end with English or numbers
m_chinese_underline_valid: Cannot enter Chinese characters and underscores
m_layout_change_tips: Switching the layout will automatically reset the layout, and the previous layout will be overwritten. Do you confirm the operation?
m_noProcessPermission: Operation Failed: No permission to use the current process
m_threshold_tips: Please enter a number for the threshold
m_time_tips: Please enter a positive number for time
m_calculation_tip1: Color scheme: Used as the default color scheme for the indicator, applied in custom dashboards.
m_calculation_tip3: 3.Indicator Key: Unique identifier of the indicator.
m_calculation_tip4: 4.Statistical Parameters: Basic data of the indicator, sourced from the acquisition parameters configured above.
m_calculation_tip5: 5.Filter Tags: Tags supported for filtering the indicator when configuring alerts and dashboards. Condition fields are sourced from acquisition parameters, and optional condition values are sourced from business-configured tag values + actual acquisition values (e.g., failure quantity can only filter by service code, while categorized failure quantity can filter by both service code and return code).
m_calculation_tip6: 6.Calculation Type: The formula used to calculate the indicator, allowing other indicators to be used as parameters.
m_calculation_tip7: 7.Automatic Alert: A toggle to control whether alerts are created.
m_calculation_tip8: 8.Threshold Alert Configuration: Becomes effective when automatic alerts are enabled, automatically generating alerts according to the template rules.
m_alarm_query_tips: Please enter the alarm level, name, indicator or object
m_recommended_system_configuration_tips: The following mapping is recommended by the system and needs to be saved to take effect

m_custom_scrape_tip: Paste scrape job list only (starting with - job_name). Do not paste a full prometheus.yml. Save writes an isolated file wrapped as scrape_configs, referenced by scrape_config_files.
m_custom_scrape_format_done: Indent aligned to Prometheus scrape config, please review and save
m_k8s_local_collection_disabled: Local collection and alerting are disabled. Object discovery, Agent log processing and configuration delivery continue.
m_k8s_local_collection_history: Local collection is disabled. Only existing history is available; gaps are not filled with zero. External Prometheus data is not automatically shown here.
m_k8s_alert_rules_paused: Local collection and alerting are disabled. Rules can be edited and retained but are not evaluated. Log matching rules continue to be delivered.
